# Ledger

> Convert a PDF bank statement to Excel or CSV in the browser. The file never leaves this device.

The public origin is https://stmt-local.vercel.app. Operated by Ultimatum. Contact ultaultimatum@gmail.com.

## Tools

* [Convert statement](https://stmt-local.vercel.app) — PDF → Excel/CSV in this tab.

## Guides

* [Locked PDF](https://stmt-local.vercel.app/password) — Password stays in the tab.
* [How it works](https://stmt-local.vercel.app/how-it-works) — Tables, not OCR of a photo.
* [FAQ](https://stmt-local.vercel.app/faq) — Privacy.
* [Use cases](https://stmt-local.vercel.app/use-cases) — Accountant, budget, multi-page.
* [Accountant](https://stmt-local.vercel.app/use-cases/accountant) — One packet per client.
* [Budget](https://stmt-local.vercel.app/use-cases/budget) — CSV into a sheet.
* [Multi-page](https://stmt-local.vercel.app/use-cases/multi-page) — What a long statement does.

## Not on this origin

* Bytes stay in the tab. There is no conversion API and no `/blogs/` cluster.
